changes: Native photo bytes stored in immutable ArrayBuffer records; progress metadata commits separately in the existing IndexedDB stores.
Existing legacy Blob records remain untouched by unrelated progress; readable originals migrate lazily without conversion.
Immutable reconstructed photo cache and metadata-only intake listing prevent repeated full-photo reads.
Bounded arrayBuffer, FileReader and Response fallbacks read exact originals; upload bodies reconstructed from verified bytes.
Exact card/create/enqueue/upload intents and reconciliation behavior preserved, including unknown outcomes.
referenceBoundary: WebKit file-backed IndexedDB Blob issue is an engineering analogue, not proof of this owner device OS/root exception.
dataPolicy: No actual card IDs, original photos, customer identities, photo hashes, credentials, sessions, or raw private logs copied into these safe receipts.
